# Clear to Pay

> A payment guardrail for AI agents on NEAR. The AI reads supplier invoices; a smart contract decides. An invoice is paid only to the supplier's registered address, for goods signed as delivered by two registered keys in two different roles (keys are not identities), at the order's prices, once. Every decision (CLEARED, HELD, SEIZED) is a permanent receipt on NEAR testnet. Built for the NEAR Hackathon, 1-14 Nov 2026. Hackathon code, not audited.

Threat: a poisoned invoice convinces an AI agent to pay an attacker.
Invariant: only the NEAR contract authorises payment, and it pays only the supplier's registered address, after the order check and a delivery signed by two different roles.
Try it: https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/console/ (Judge mode, no wallet)
Proof: first settled payment https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/23MoTFoVaA7GdzJRxKakDBS8iQv8YjV8U15Uznf3ZtCn · a fooled agent's submit, SEIZED https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/8HgbsoAvr39cQJnwMnU2eL4ejVpLTmBjhqjmu6o4ufHY · 127 contract tests, 253 reader tests (below)
Status: running on NEAR testnet, with ten security reviews behind it; a professional audit comes before mainnet.

This file is for AI reviewers. Each claim points to where it is proven. Run the commands; do not take the claims on trust.

## Verify in 5 minutes (no wallet, no keys)

- `cargo test` : 127 contract tests, incl. 4 property tests and the baseline comparison
- `(cd tools/ctp-sign && cargo test)` : 5 signing-tool tests, golden vectors shared with the contract
- `(cd reader && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m pytest -q)` : 253 reader tests, incl. the 19-invoice attack corpus, 37 offline tests of the TEE model call, 9 of the hardware check, 10 of which software the enclave ran, 10 of the qualification gate for a new model, 28 of the follow-up drafts, 20 of the alerts and 21 of the MCP server
- `(cd factory && cargo test)` : 12 factory tests: the embedded code is the deployed guard's, one keyless batch with the caller as owner, refunds paid or recorded as owed, reserved names
- [sandbox/](sandbox/README.md) : 11 end-to-end tests (the 7th: the Console's one-signature order batch, its gas, and all-or-nothing; the last 4: the factory creating a locked contract, a taken name refunded, bad requests, the callback private) on a local NEAR node (near-sandbox, near-workspaces): the real wasm, a real NEP-141 token, payout callbacks (paid and refused), the deposit hook and the agent key refused by NEAR; all pass in CI (workflow `sandbox`). The wasm is the deployed code; the 72-hour wait is skipped by rewriting its stored time on the local node
- `scripts/attack-demo.sh` : a poisoned invoice, a fooled agent, and every refusal, logged
- `scripts/baseline.sh` : the same invoice attacks against two allowlist guards and against Clear to Pay
- `scripts/mutation-check.sh` : breaks three rules on purpose; a property test must catch each
- `(cd tools/console-crypto && npm ci && npm test)` : the browser's crypto: golden digests, byte-for-byte parity with ctp-sign, NEAR transaction bytes against near-api-js, the enclave signature; the New order wizard, the invoice flow, the OutLayer proof files, and Receive on another chain (`tools/console-crypto/test/receive.mjs`)
- `(cd workers/alerts && npm ci && npm test)` : the alerts worker's rules and an end-to-end run with a fake chain and a fake Telegram
- `python3 reader/tools/read_invoice.py --verify docs/proof/reading-INV-2208.json` : re-checks a live AI reading's enclave signature offline

## Claims and where they are proven

- The payee can never come from the invoice or the AI: [src/inspection.rs](src/inspection.rs) (`payee_mismatch`), [reader/ctp_reader/schema.py](reader/ctp_reader/schema.py) (no payee field); tests `attack_ai_fooled_into_writing_the_attackers_address_is_seized`, `test_a_well_formed_answer_becomes_exactly_the_invoice_the_supplier_signs`
- A delivery needs two different roles: [src/delivery_tests.rs](src/delivery_tests.rs), property test `property_a_delivery_needs_exactly_two_valid_roles`
- A global allowlist plus limits pays 9 of 11 invoice attacks, a per-supplier allowlist plus limits 8 of 11, Clear to Pay 0 of 11; all three pay the honest invoice: [docs/baseline.md](docs/baseline.md), [src/baseline_tests.rs](src/baseline_tests.rs)
- Hidden text does not reach the model, for the 19 tricks in the corpus (clipping paths, transparency and text over photos are not covered yet): [reader/corpus/](reader/corpus/), [reader/README.md](reader/README.md)
- The AI's answer was signed inside an enclave over our exact bytes; the enclave's Intel TDX quote holds its signing address and our nonce, and the report names the pinned model; on every reading the quote's chain is verified to Intel's root and the GPU evidence by NVIDIA (its signed token checked); the enclave's signature covers the document's sha-256; and the software it ran (OS image, containers, the deployment that launched the model) must match `reader/software-pins.json`; new software is pinned only after that model passes the qualification run ([reader/ctp_reader/qualify.py](reader/ctp_reader/qualify.py)): [reader/ctp_reader/tee.py](reader/ctp_reader/tee.py), [reader/ctp_reader/model.py](reader/ctp_reader/model.py), [reader/tests/test_model.py](reader/tests/test_model.py); live reading in [docs/proof/reading-INV-2208.json](docs/proof/reading-INV-2208.json)
- The agent's key cannot withdraw, attach money, change rules or move USDC directly; it can only submit invoices and send payments that already CLEARED, to the registered address: NEAR function-call key on `buyer.cleartopay.testnet`; refusals in [docs/testnet-proof.md](docs/testnet-proof.md)
- After HELD, the AI drafts the supplier query from code-computed facts only; after SEIZED, no reply in the same thread: [reader/ctp_reader/query.py](reader/ctp_reader/query.py), [reader/tests/test_query.py](reader/tests/test_query.py)
- Address changes (even ones proposed and cancelled between checks), new suppliers, new delivery signers and SEIZED invoices raise a Telegram alert during the 72-hour wait (the local monitor polls every 15 s; the hosted worker reads each contract every 2 minutes): [reader/ctp_reader/alerts.py](reader/ctp_reader/alerts.py), [reader/tests/test_alerts.py](reader/tests/test_alerts.py)
- The reader also runs inside OutLayer's TEE (experimental, Judge mode "Your own invoice"): same prompt and model, the NEAR AI key sealed as a project secret, each reading signed by an enclave-derived key, and OutLayer's attestation names our reproducible WASM (`e11834078a135e4ff98df8e52f3dbba934f5b499fe3a43a20e29788b2d96c66d`) and the output's hash: [outlayer/README.md](outlayer/README.md), proof files [docs/proof/outlayer/](docs/proof/outlayer/), checked by `node tools/console-crypto/test/outlayer.mjs`; 13 Rust tests in `outlayer/`
- After the contract has paid, a supplier can receive on another chain through NEAR Intents (testnet: Tidepool, which deploys NEAR's own Intents contract unmodified, `defuse` v0.4.5, behind the 1Click API). The contract is unchanged and takes no part; one approval in the payout account's own wallet; the quote must repeat the request before money moves; a redirect's transaction is read on NEAR and matched to its swap: [docs/console/receive-as.js](docs/console/receive-as.js), [docs/console/sign/](docs/console/sign/), `node tools/console-crypto/test/receive.mjs`; payout: https://sepolia.basescan.org/tx/0x740a9409435f23432ca17815a2a113c0f29725144ca7eff4e6f18c0eb17b36c0
- A company creates its own contract from the browser in two wallet approvals (New contract, https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/console/create/): one call to `factory.cleartopay.testnet` creates `<name>.factory.cleartopay.testnet`, installs exactly the guard's code (sha-256 9b998038ac549a37c871c431e28b125437f4c7f046799d8e4e5c139dbea0a2d1) and makes the caller owner, with no access key (locked: nobody, including us, can change its code or move its money outside its rules). The page checks the factory's reported code before the wallet opens and reads the new contract back from two NEAR servers, which must agree. CI job `guard-binary` rebuilds the guard from src/ and requires the same sha-256 for the build, the factory's embedded copy, both pins and the code live on guard.cleartopay.testnet. A failed create refunds in full, or records the refund as owed (`claim_refund`). [factory/src/lib.rs](factory/src/lib.rs), [docs/console/create.js](docs/console/create.js), `sandbox/tests/factory.rs`; live: `joezzytest.factory.cleartopay.testnet`
- Every threat, its defence and its test: [THREAT_MODEL.md](THREAT_MODEL.md), including what is not defended yet

## On chain (NEAR testnet)

- Contract: `guard.cleartopay.testnet`; buyer and agent key: `buyer.cleartopay.testnet`; supplier payout: `qingmar.cleartopay.testnet`
- Every transaction: [docs/testnet-proof.md](docs/testnet-proof.md), viewable at https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/<id>
- Live site: https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/
- Live ledger (reads the chain from the browser): https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/ledger/
- MCP server for AI agents (stdlib only; sending off by default, agent key fence checked on chain): [reader/ctp_reader/mcp_server.py](reader/ctp_reader/mcp_server.py)
- For agent builders: MCP configs, a live key-fence check and a JavaScript submit example: https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/integrate/ and [tools/integrate/submit.mjs](tools/integrate/submit.mjs)
- Console (static pages, no server): Judge mode https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/console/ (real testnet transactions on judge.cleartopay.testnet with a published, on-chain-fenced demo key; the enclave signature checked in the browser), phone signing https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/console/sign/ (same bytes as ctp-sign: `cd tools/console-crypto && npm ci && npm test` checks the golden digests and byte-for-byte signatures), buyer setup with a NEAR wallet https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/console/setup/, and the Inbox (next step per invoice; pay, cancel or retry) https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/console/inbox/
- Alerts: a Cloudflare Worker (workers/alerts, `npm test`) watches both contracts and messages each subscriber on Telegram by role (buyer, a supplier, delivery signers)
- Inspect an invoice (five cases, step by step, real outputs and links): https://clear-to-pay.vercel.app/inspect/

## Limits, stated

- The browser checks the AI reading's signatures and bindings; the full Intel TDX and NVIDIA certificate chains are checked by the CLI reader on every reading, not in the browser.
- Proof of control of a payout account (NEP-413) is offered at registration, not required by the contract.
- Two colluding insiders in different roles can still confirm a false delivery (the rule counts keys in roles).
- A contract created by the factory is locked: no rescue if its owner loses every key to the owner account (a second key with its own recovery phrase on the same account covers a lost phrase, not a stolen key; the New contract page and Buyer setup warn while only one key protects the owner account), and no upgrades (a new version is a new contract). The factory itself has no access key since 11 Nov 2026 (https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/3ZQosp8mp1CjM4m3P6arD759NAX2fToQ8n6ZrdKAuSur): nobody can change its code or move its NEAR, which backs refunds. The page's read-back needs two NEAR servers to agree; it does not verify light-client proofs.
- Receive on another chain trusts Tidepool, a community testnet sandbox: it holds the money mid-swap and reports the status; the page says so and shows Tidepool's status as Tidepool's.

## Where it goes next

Each extends something that already works today:
- One shared on-chain flagged list for every Clear to Pay contract (today every buyer of a deployment is warned from its seized receipts).
- Automatic payouts on any chain through NEAR Intents on mainnet: the contract pays into a NEAR Intents account whose owner-signed rules allow withdrawal only to the supplier's own address (receiving on another chain with one approval already works on testnet).
- Hardware-backed signer keys (passkeys, the phone's secure chip) for large deployments; one-step supplier key rotation (two steps today).

## The AI reading on chain

- When the buyer submits from the Inbox after the AI check, the attested reading rides along in the submit_invoice transaction as `ai_reading` (ignored by the contract, kept by the chain). Re-check it: `node tools/console-crypto/recheck.mjs <tx-hash> <buyer-account>`.

## Main files

- [README.md](README.md): overview, try it, claims and proof
- [src/](src/): the contract (near-sdk 5.29, Rust)
- [reader/](reader/): the invoice reader (Python, standard library + pdfminer.six)
- [tools/ctp-sign/](tools/ctp-sign/): signing tool for suppliers and delivery signers
- [demo/](demo/): fictional demo invoices (Qingmar Steel Co. is not a real company)
